Charred Scallion Fried Rice

Ingredients

Yield: 4 servings
  • 3tablespoons neutral oil, such as canola
  • 1bunch scallions, thinly sliced, whites and greens separated

Cooking Notes

  • I added frozen peas at the end.
  • Day-old rice really matters.
